subject: Pilot onboarding: request for PO-exception for Nova Analytics POC
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah@nova-analytics.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 15:07:00 -0700
Subject: Nova Analytics — onboarding & pilot (PO question)

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo today — the engineering team is excited to run a short technical pilot integrating Redwood’s hosted inference into Nova’s analytics pipeline. We want to get the 6-week POC started the week of Nov 8.

A couple of quick operational questions so we can complete internal approvals at Nova:
- Do you require a purchase order for a short pilot (est. $32,000 total), or can we proceed on a no-PO invoice (Net 30) for the pilot period?
- If a PO is required, what lead time should we expect from Redwood finance to issue an invoice?

I’ve attached our vendor onboarding packet and W-9 for your team. Please let me know who on your side handles PO exceptions — if an exception is possible we can route via our procurement quickly.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf, nova_w9.pdf

Best,
Sarah Lin
Head of Integrations | Nova Analytics
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Nova Analytics — onboarding & pilot (PO question)

Monica — forwarding Nova's onboarding packet. They want to start a 6-week POC (~$32k) the week of Nov 8 and are asking whether a PO is required for pilots. Can we consider an exception (no-PO invoice) for this case?

Why I think exception is reasonable: small dollar, timeboxed pilot, strong product fit (we forecast expansion if pilot succeeds). Marcus — I cc'd you so you can weigh in from sales/forecast.

Key asks for procurement: 1) Whether we can accept Nova as vendor on invoice-only for the pilot and 2) Any required paperwork (we already have W-9 + onboarding form attached).

Attachments forwarded: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf, nova_w9.pdf

Thanks,
Rachel
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0199
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Nova Analytics — onboarding & pilot (PO question)

Thanks for the heads up, Rachel. A few clarifying items before procurement can provide an exception:
1) Confirm total expected spend for pilot and billing cadence (single invoice vs. monthly).
2) Confirm who owns the SOW and whether there’s a roll-off clause if pilot doesn't convert.
3) Risk check: any customer data residency or special security requirements for the pilot? (If so, we may need a short security questionnaire completed.)

If pilot is <= $35k, timeboxed, and no unusual data handling, procurement can approve invoice-only onboarding as a one-time exception, but this requires finance sign-off. I’ve looped in Laura for finance approval.

If you can get the signed SOW and confirm billing cadence, I’ll expedite the exception request.

- Monica
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah@nova-analytics.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Nova Analytics — onboarding & pilot (PO question)

Monica / Laura — thanks. Quick answers from my side and Nova:
- Total pilot commitment: $32,000 (single invoice at completion of pilot; vendor prefers single invoice to speed processing).
- SOW: attached — short statement of work (pilot-sow.pdf). It includes a 2-week evaluation milestone and automatic termination at the pilot end if no written extension is signed.
- Data/security: No regulated data for the POC; Nova will only send synthetic data and hashed identifiers for testing. They confirmed they will not onboard customer PII during pilot.

Attachments: pilot-sow.pdf, nova_onboarding_form.pdf, vendor-w9.pdf

Requesting finance sign-off for a one-time no-PO invoice exception so we can bill at pilot completion. If approved, please confirm any required invoice wording or PO code we should reference.

Rachel
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Nova Analytics — onboarding & pilot (PO question)

Rachel / Monica — I reviewed the packet and SOW. Finance will approve a one-time no-PO exception for this pilot under the following conditions:
1) Pilot spend capped at $32,000 with single invoice at completion.
2) Invoice must reference exception code EXC-PO-2026-7834 and include the signed SOW.
3) Marketing/sales must confirm in writing that this is a timeboxed trial with explicit conversion discussion before any extension.

Please have Nova sign the SOW and upload the final SOW + vendor W-9 to the procurement SharePoint link here: https://redwood.sharepoint.com/sites/procurement/requests/DEAL-7834. Once uploaded, I will issue the exception approval and tell Accounts Payable to accept a single invoice (Net 30).

Approver: Laura Bennett, Director of Finance | Redwood Inference
(approval token: EXC-PO-2026-7834)

Laura
